title: Tacet task.planned payload

dependsOn.description: Ids of sub-tasks in the same plan that must complete first

indivisible.description: The work cannot be handed off cleanly part-way (e.g. one long read), so a larger context window may be used where config allows it (#110)

description: A task's plan. Invariants (checked by Tacet, not by this schema): sub-task ids are unique; dependsOn names only sub-tasks of the same plan, never the sub-task itself, and has no duplicates; the dependency graph has no cycles; each task.planned is the full current plan: a replan lists every sub-task again, completed ones included.
x-tacet-invariants: dependsOn names only sub-tasks of the same plan, never the sub-task itself, and has no duplicates
the dependency graph has no cycles
each task.planned is the full current plan: a replan lists every sub-task again, completed ones included
